findings.title: Plant fallback in Patch_BestFoodSourceOnMap still caps regions at a hard-coded 30
findings.detail: Vanilla's animal branch of BestFoodSourceOnMap uses GetMaxRegionsToScan(getter, forceScanWholeMap): 100 regions for player-faction animals, or the pen's connected regions for penned roamers. The new MaxRegions delegate was applied to EatNonFoodJob only. In the GenClosest call at Source/TitanDiet.cs:149, replace `forceScanWholeMap ? -1 : 30` with `TitanDietUtility.MaxRegions(getter, forceScanWholeMap)`, making the field internal, so the plant search covers the same area as vanilla's.

findings.title: The hunts+Corpse ConfigError cannot see the same conflict across two traits
findings.detail: The check reads one def's diet. In TitanDiet.Build, trait A with hunts=true plus trait B removing Corpse with hunts unset merges to hunts=true with Corpse removed, because line 81 only forces false when hunts is still null. The creature then eats its kill, which is the case the new message warns about, and nothing is logged. A runtime warning in Build, or a doc line on the field, would cover it.

findings.title: MethodDelegate in a static initializer ties all of TitanDietUtility to one private method
findings.detail: The signature matches the current game, so it binds today. If a game update renames or re-signs GetMaxRegionsToScan, the static constructor throws. Every call to WithinRope and EatNonFoodJob then raises TypeInitializationException, and that includes the BestFoodSourceOnMap postfix validator, so the error repeats on every food search. A null-tolerant lookup with a fallback value would contain it. This is my opinion on future-proofing, not a current break.
